name: Wedding Photo Hunter
description: Traces connections outward from Facebook contacts you name, looking for photos from a wedding, and downloads whatever it turns up into a local folder. Depends on the guests having posted publicly enough to be found, so results vary with how social the wedding party was.

official.title: Wedding Photo Hunter by Alex
official.description: Finds wedding photos by walking the Facebook guest graph from people you already know, then saves them to a folder on your computer.
